subject: Aligning demo scope after self-serve sign-up: throughput, security, and slot options
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@glowcommerce.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick background + request for a short demo after our sign-up

Hi Sofia,

Thanks — we just completed the self-serve sign-up and I'm hoping to get a short walk-through so we can validate Redwood for a small pilot. A few quick details on our side to help scope the call: 

- Use case: customer support augmentation (retrieval + generative summarization for incoming tickets).
- Expected monthly volume: ~1.2M messages, ~120M tokens/month.
- Typical message size: 400-800 tokens.
- Concurrency: peak ~60 concurrent requests during business hours, average ~12.
- Timeline: aiming to run a 6-week pilot starting mid-May.
- Security: we'll need SOC2 evidence and clarification on VPC/private deployment options.

I've attached a small traffic snapshot (glowcommerce-traffic-snapshot.csv) and a short deck that shows message distribution. Could you advise whether we should demo hosted vs dedicated capacity for this profile, and propose 2–3 short slots (30–40 minutes) next week? We're Pacific time.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering | GlowCommerce
alex@glowcommerce.com
(415) 555-0132
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@glowcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo scope after self-serve sign-up: throughput, security, and slot options

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for the context + the traffic CSV. I've skimmed the snapshot and a couple of quick clarifying questions so we align the demo and avoid rework in the pilot phase: 

1) Concurrency profile: is the 60 concurrent peak all in a single region or split across US & EU? If split, what % is US vs EU?
2) Latency SLO: are you targeting p95 < 250ms for short responses, or is 500–700ms acceptable for heavier prompts?
3) Model/ops: do you expect to test more than one model family (e.g., a smaller base + a higher-quality model) during the pilot?
4) Security/Compliance: do you already have a SOC2 report to share, or should we prepare the SOC2 pack for you during the pilot scoping?
5) Authentication: will your team require SSO into a dedicated console or will API-key-based access be sufficient for the pilot?

Proposed short slots (30–40m) next week — pick any that work for you: 
- Wed 16 Apr, 10:00–10:40 PT
- Thu 17 Apr, 14:00–14:40 PT
- Fri 18 Apr, 09:00–09:40 PT

If none of those fit, tell me a few windows and Ben (cc'd) will coordinate. For the demo we'll: 
- Validate model choice and latency expectations against your CSV,
- Walk through Dedicated vs Hosted cost tradeoffs for your profile,
- Cover a short security checklist (SOC2, data residency), and
- Outline pilot milestones and success criteria.

Attaching a short prep doc (redwood-demo-prep.pdf) — it has an optional checklist your engineers can fill out before the call.

Thanks,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@glowcommerce.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo scope after self-serve sign-up: throughput, security, and slot options

Hi Alex — Ben from Redwood here, jumping in to coordinate timing. Sofia's times look good — quick note on availability: we have a capacity deep-dive slot on Thu 17 Apr at 14:00 PT (Sofia listed that already) but Sofia has a hard blocker at 14:30, so I'd recommend we either lock 14:00–14:40 and plan a tight agenda, or move to Fri 18 Apr 09:00 PT. 

Quick asks that will help prep the demo: 
- Can you confirm whether traffic includes attachments or binary blobs in requests (we've seen some customers store base64 payloads which changes the token footprint)?
- Any SSO provider (Okta, Azure AD) details if you need console access?

If you'd like, we can run a short sandbox test in advance (20–30m) to push a small synthetic workload so you can see latencies on our hosted and dedicated configurations. That helps make the demo concrete.

Also attaching the prep PDF Sofia mentioned. If Thu 14:00 works we can keep that — otherwise say Fri 09:00 and we'll update the calendar invite.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior SDR | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex@glowcommerce.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo scope after self-serve sign-up: throughput, security, and slot options

Hi Sofia / Ben — thanks for the quick turn. Thu 17 Apr at 14:00 PT works for our core team (we can keep it tight). Answers below: 

- Concurrency is US-dominant (~85% US, 15% EU).
- Latency: target p95 ~300ms; occasional 500ms acceptable for long summaries.
- Models: we'll want to validate both a higher-throughput smaller model for bulk classification and a higher-quality model for final summarization (two-model approach).
- Traffic: includes occasional small attachments (mostly screenshots) but payloads are not base64-embedded in the request body.
- SOC2: we have an internal SOC2 report and can share a redacted copy before the demo.
- SSO: Okta — we'll scope console access after pilot kickoff.

Confirming Thu 17 Apr, 14:00–14:40 PT. Please send a calendar invite and a Meet link. We'll have Alex R. + Priya Sinha join.

See you then — Alex
